seo.title: AC Repair, Maintenance & Duct Cleaning | Hannah Care
seo.description: AC repair, maintenance, duct cleaning, coil cleaning, installation and annual contracts for homes and businesses. Same-day service, Monday to Saturday.

hero.headline: Cool, clean air back, fast.
hero.subheadline: Expert repair, servicing, cleaning and installation for split, FCU and package AC units in homes and commercial properties.

image.alt: Technician removing filters from a split AC unit
image.brief: Technician servicing a split AC unit in a bright residential room.

intro.title: Everything your AC needs, under one roof.
intro.text: A well-kept AC cools better, uses less energy and lasts longer. Whether it has stopped cooling, is leaking water, or simply needs a service, our in-house technicians diagnose the real cause and fix it properly.

services.title: AC Repair Service
services.text: AC not cooling, weak airflow, strange noises or water leaking? We find the root cause and repair it, often in a single visit.

image.alt: Technician diagnosing an outdoor AC unit with refrigerant gauges
image.brief: Technician checking AC pressure and refrigerant performance with professional gauges.

services.title: AC Maintenance Service
services.text: Regular servicing keeps your AC efficient and helps prevent costly breakdowns, especially before the hot season.

image.alt: Technician washing a reusable AC filter
image.brief: Technician carefully washing an AC filter during routine maintenance.

services.title: AC Duct Cleaning
services.text: Our specialist duct cleaning removes dust, debris and accumulated contaminants from accessible ductwork, helping air flow freely and your space feel fresher.

image.alt: Technician cleaning a ceiling AC duct
image.brief: Professional vacuum equipment cleaning a ceiling AC duct and vent.

services.title: Full AC System Cleaning
services.text: A thorough clean of your complete AC system, indoor and outdoor, to restore airflow, efficiency and cooling.

image.alt: Technician deep cleaning an indoor split AC unit
image.brief: Split AC unit protected with a wash bag while the internal system is deep cleaned.

services.title: AC Coil Cleaning
services.text: Dirty coils force your AC to work harder. We clean evaporator and condenser coils so your unit cools better and runs more efficiently.

image.alt: Outdoor AC condenser coil being cleaned
image.brief: Close-up of an outdoor condenser coil being washed with a professional sprayer.

services.title: Annual Maintenance Contract
services.text: Scheduled servicing and routine checks all year round, with visit frequency and scope tailored to your property.

image.alt: Hannah Care technician reviewing a maintenance checklist on a tablet
image.brief: Uniformed technician documenting scheduled maintenance on a tablet.

services.title: AC Installation
services.text: Professional installation and replacement of AC units, completed neatly and tested before we leave.
bullets: Replacement of old units with new ones

image.alt: Two technicians installing a split AC unit
image.brief: Two technicians carefully mounting a split AC unit in a residential room.

services.title: Insulation
services.text: Proper insulation of AC piping protects efficiency, reduces condensation and keeps installations neat and long-lasting.

image.alt: Insulated AC pipes
image.brief: Neatly wrapped and insulated pipes.

steps.title: Contact us
steps.text: Call, WhatsApp or send the form.

steps.title: Diagnosis & quote
steps.text: We find the cause and explain the cost upfront.

steps.title: Repair or service
steps.text: Done by a certified technician with the right tools.

steps.title: Test & handover
steps.text: We test performance and tidy up before we leave.

items.q: Why is my AC not cooling properly?
items.a: Common causes include dirty filters or coils, drain blockages or component faults. Our technician will diagnose the exact cause before recommending a repair.

items.q: How often should my AC be serviced?
items.a: Regular servicing, typically at least once a year and often more for heavily used units, helps keep your AC efficient. An Annual Maintenance Contract makes this easy.

items.q: What does AC duct cleaning involve?
items.a: We clean supply and return ducts, vents, grilles and diffusers, removing dust and debris from accessible ductwork. Scope is agreed before the job.

items.q: Can you install a new AC or replace my old one?
items.a: Yes. We install and replace split AC units, including piping, drain and electrical connection, then test the system.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance contracts for businesses?
items.a: Yes. We offer both residential and commercial Annual Maintenance Contracts, tailored to your property and visit frequency.

finalCta.title: Get your AC running right again.
finalCta.text: Call, WhatsApp or request a free quote. Our team is ready to help.

items.q: Why does my circuit breaker keep tripping?
items.a: It can be caused by overload, a faulty appliance or a wiring fault. Our electrician will trace the cause and fix it safely.

items.q: Can you handle commercial electrical work?
items.a: Yes. We work in homes, offices, shops and other commercial properties.

items.q: How quickly can you attend an electrical issue?
items.a: We offer same-day service where availability allows. Call or WhatsApp us Monday to Saturday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and we will respond as quickly as possible.

items.q: Can you rewire an older property?
